title: Hospitality reopening and lockdown-restriction rally at Heroes' Square
organizer: Aron and Szilard Ecsenyi; Le az Adok 75%-aval party and Tomeges Uzletnyitas initiative
participants_original: Telex correspondent: about 300 participants, excluding dozens of journalists and police; Euronews: a few hundred; RFE/RL: hundreds.
threshold_50_evidence: Opened original Telex and Euronews reports independently describe hundreds, establishing at least 50 without inventing exact bounds.

title.summary: The January 31 public gathering at Heroes Square is established by a correspondent, the police release and a Reuters caption; no earlier physical onset for this assembly is documented.

end_date.summary: Participants physically drifted away and the whole gathering finished within one hour. This dates only the bounded January 31 assembly.

organizer.summary: Telex identifies the Ecsenyi brothers and the party or initiative; field spellings are rendered without diacritics.

demands.summary: Speeches demanded relaxation of government closure restrictions, improved wage support and a lower tax burden.

participants_original.summary: About 300 and qualitative hundreds were reported; no numerical minimum or maximum is fabricated. RFE/RL draws on Reuters and AFP.

participants_estimate.summary: About 300 and qualitative hundreds were reported; no numerical minimum or maximum is fabricated. RFE/RL draws on Reuters and AFP.

participants_precision.summary: About 300 and qualitative hundreds were reported; no numerical minimum or maximum is fabricated. RFE/RL draws on Reuters and AFP.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: About 300 and qualitative hundreds were reported; no numerical minimum or maximum is fabricated. RFE/RL draws on Reuters and AFP.

protester_violence.summary: Telex explicitly reports no atrocity or resistance to police apart from shouting.

state_response.crowd_dispersal.summary: A police cordon pushed people out and officers warned them about assembly offences. Attempted displacement meets the manual definition of dispersal.

state_response.summary: Identity checks, warnings, fines and proceedings are documented. Arrests, accommodation, shootings, killings, beatings and ignore remain unknown where the sources do not establish them.

eligibility.summary: Occurrence, domestic target and threshold are supported, but January 31 versus February 1 episode grouping remains unresolved.

episode_key.summary: Occurrence, domestic target and threshold are supported, but January 31 versus February 1 episode grouping remains unresolved.

notes: Demands concerned domestic government restrictions, wage support and the tax burden. Party involvement does not turn a policy-demand rally into election support. The physical January 31 assembly ended within an hour; the campaign or episode end is not asserted. The same organisers held another physical gathering on February 1, with 100-150 people according to Index citing Magyar Hang. This relationship requires review. Six mask cases and organiser fines are not arrests. January 25 was an earlier announcement or rescheduling lead, without a verified assembly.
open_questions: Should the physically separated January 31 and February 1 gatherings form one episode under the additional Coding Procedure?
Independently verify the alleged organiser fine total and responses not described by the sources.

title: University autonomy walk outside Szeged University

participants_original: Opened Szeged.hu: many people, without a count. Blocked Szeged365 search card: two or three dozen students; the body was not verified.
threshold_50_evidence: Not established. The opened body lacks a count; an unverified lower search estimate suggests fewer than 50 and requires follow-up.
